correctness.rationale: A retained isolated indicator has mean pq^r. For adjacent endpoints the joint event is impossible, while nonadjacent endpoints with s common neighbors impose absence on a union of 2r−s sites disjoint from the endpoints. Summing diagonal, nr/2 adjacent and nonadjacent pair terms produces the stated factors, with codegree zero canceling. The normalized variance residual divides by 2p³q^r, nonzero at every permitted sample, and the geometric series gives triangular coefficients b_j=∑_{s≥r−j}N_s. Adjacent coefficient differences and exact interpolation at r distinct points prove inversion, including r=1 and the complete graph. The wedge count partitions into ∑sN_s open and 3T closed wedges. At cubic order the variance coefficient before substitution is n binom(r,2)+2nr(r+1)+2∑sN_s, which simplifies as claimed. The two cycle examples have ten distance-two pairs of codegree one and none of codegree two; disconnectedness is permitted. The uploaded certificate and checker were inspected, not executed. A separate exact retained-set enumeration and three-point interpolation for K3,3 and the triangular prism gave triangle counts 0 and 2 and the expected distinct normalized curves (python /workspace/review-evidence/independent_checks.py). The independent check is finite and numerical stability is not asserted.
